capabilities: Capture links, notes, clipboard links and selected text into a queue
Fetch a link's title, description and favicon
Browse and search resources in a list or Kanban board
Change status by dragging cards between columns
Store each resource as a Markdown file with frontmatter and a Notes section
extras: README describes installation for when the plugin becomes available in the Community plugins browser, plus manual installation from a GitHub release; requires Obsidian 1.7.2 or newer.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in place to park links and ideas for later and track whether they have been read.
summary: Read-later queue that saves links, notes and ideas as Markdown files and browses them in a list or Kanban board.
